title: Concept: Hapi Boom error object returned to a client
description: A Boom error object with the isBoom marker and the originating stack in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The object carries the handler's internal error name and payload, which is more detail than a client needs and often includes the query that failed.
applicability: Deployments that render a Boom error object with the isBoom marker and the originating stack into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The object carries the handler's internal error name and payload, which is more detail than a client needs and often includes the query that failed.
